title: Sharp Oracle-Regret Tradeoffs for Projection-Free Online Convex Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.00254v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We characterize the regret attainable in online convex optimization when access to the feasible set is limited to an exact linear optimization oracle. The learner is given an inscribed ball and a diameter bound and must remain feasible on every consistent instance. For convex $G$-Lipschitz losses, diameter at most $D$, a total allowance of $Q$ oracle calls, and a strict limit of $B$ calls per round, the dimension-free minimax expected regret is $\Theta(GD\max\{\sqrt T,T/(1+\min\{Q,BT\})^{1/4}\})$. The lower bound applies to arbitrary randomized learners. Universal feasibility first forces each action into the hull of the supplied ball and the preceding oracle replies. A fixed-body construction then couples fresh phase directions to a shared simplex, making useful replies costly repeatedly even though all losses have a common minimizer. A counted approximate-gradient method with interleaved blocks attains the matching rate. Total-budget a

translated_title: 免投影在线凸优化中Oracle调用与后悔值的精确权衡
translated_abstract: 我们刻画了当对可行集的访问仅限于精确线性优化预言机时，在线凸优化中可达到的后悔值。学习算法被给定一个内切球和一个直径上界，并且必须在每个一致的实例上保持可行。对于凸的 $G$-Lipschitz 损失、直径至多为 $D$、总共允许 $Q$ 次预言机调用、以及每轮严格限制 $B$ 次调用的情形，无维度的极小极大期望后悔为 $\Theta(GD\max\{\sqrt T,T/(1+\min\{Q,BT\})^{1/4}\})$。该下界适用于任意随机化学习算法。普遍可行性首先迫使每个动作进入所给球与先前预言机回复的凸包之中；随后，一种固定体构造将新的相位方向耦合到共享单纯形上，使得即使所有损失函数拥有共同的最小化点，有用的回复仍被反复地变得代价高昂。一种采用交错块的计数近似梯度方法达到了与之匹配的速率。总预算…（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文证明了免投影在线凸优化中后悔值与Oracle调用预算（总预算Q与每轮预算B）之间的紧致极小极大权衡，其无维度期望后悔为 $\Theta(GD\max\{\sqrt T,T/(1+\min\{Q,BT\})^{1/4}\})$，并提出了达到该速率的匹配算法。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes sharp minimax tradeoffs between regret and oracle-call budgets (total budget Q and per-round budget B) in projection-free online convex optimization, proving a dimension-free minimax expected regret of Θ(GD·max{√T, T/(1+min{Q,BT})^{1/4}}) and providing a matching counted approximate-gradient algorithm.
